description_for_model: Flypost Post provides authenticated write access to parse and publish real estate events from natural language descriptions. Browser publishing on post.goflypost.com uses Firebase authentication (Authorization: Bearer <firebase_id_token>). Machine/server-to-server publishing uses a static write token, provided via the x-flypost-write-token header or as the Bearer token.
description_for_human: Publish real estate events like open houses from natural language descriptions (authentication required).
